title: Native read-aloud through Locutus
purpose: D08, as authorized by Tom and Waffles on 2026-09-09: play, stop and replay completed answers without a second model or a blocking terminal. The README repository-local install target also records Tom’s explicit build-location instruction.
task: Implement the settings, supervised playback lifecycle, Locutus adapter and TUI controls described in docs/design/norn-voice/DESIGN.md. Resolve external request correlation and cancellation semantics before wiring the adapter.

requirements.title: Strict remembered read-aloud settings
requirements.spec: WHEN voice preferences are loaded or changed THEN the existing frontend save owner SHALL preserve and validate them, with voice off and automatic read-aloud off by default. No connection SHALL be made solely by decoding preferences.
acceptance: Unknown keys and malformed types are rejected by name
Voice preferences round-trip through the owned projection
An absent voice section retains disabled manual read-aloud

requirements.title: Supervised playback and native control
requirements.spec: WHEN a completed answer is selected for speech THEN one identified request SHALL be owned until its terminal outcome. Stop SHALL discard unsent sections and hush playback independently of provider cancellation. Replay SHALL create a new identity. Failed or uncertain outcomes SHALL be visible and SHALL NOT retry automatically.
acceptance: Stop before submission and stop during playback cannot leave queued speech audible
Completion after a stop cannot claim uninterrupted playback
Replay and source changes cannot redirect an earlier request
Disabled voice starts no audio task
A stalled hush write or receipt cannot hold the TUI past the owner-ruled five-second deadline; expiry is unknown
An untagged error after admission cannot terminate identified playback
A complete-playback receipt after a stop request retains the request in its outcome and UI wording

Turn input sources and state reset are structurally separated so run.rs stays within the 500 production-line policy; execution behaviour and existing tests are unchanged (Waffles wall ruling, 9 September 2026 15:15 Melbourne).

requirements.title: Discoverable controls and truthful proof
requirements.spec: WHEN the operator asks for read-aloud THEN TUI-local controls SHALL execute without asking the model to call a tool. Help and README SHALL state setup, stop semantics and verification limits. Full acceptance SHALL require the venue battery and review.
acceptance: Read, stop and replay are discoverable in help
Actual Locutus playback and stop are exercised before a works-claim
Exact-commit venue receipt and review are attached before landing
